At Powersystem, we deliver high-performance, cost-efficient, and future-ready steel structure construction services designed for industrial, commercial, and specialized infrastructure projects. Our expertise spans the full lifecycle—from conceptual design to final installation—ensuring robust steel solutions that meet global quality standards and local building codes across Saudi Arabia.

🔧 Turnkey Project Delivery
We handle every phase of your steel structure development:

Concept Design & Structural Engineering
Customized layouts with load optimization and design validation.

Fabrication & Manufacturing
Precision CNC-cut steel components, pre-assembled for faster on-site installation.

On-Site Erection & Finishing
Rapid and safe assembly using modern equipment and certified personnel.

Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) for warehouses, factories & workshops

Heavy-Duty Steel Frames for showrooms, logistics centers & industrial sheds

Multi-Story Steel Structures for commercial buildings and mezzanines

Steel Roofing & Cladding Systems (sandwich panels, single-skin sheets, translucent skylights)

Braced & Portal Frames engineered for seismic resistance and wind load management

Canopies, Shades & Covered Walkways for commercial and institutional use

Manufacturing & Warehousing

Oil & Gas Support Facilities

Automotive Workshops & Showrooms

Cold Storage & Food Processing Units

Educational, Healthcare & Institutional Buildings

Aviation Hangars & Logistics Hubs

✔ Fast-Track Construction
Steel structures reduce construction time significantly—ideal for time-sensitive projects.

✔ Cost Optimization
Efficient material usage and reduced labor hours translate into major savings.

✔ Sustainability Focused
We prioritize recyclable steel, energy-efficient insulation, and low-carbon fabrication processes.

✔ Design Flexibility
Custom spans, heights, and modular options tailored to your operational needs.

✔ Durability & Safety
All steel components meet ASTM and EN standards. Corrosion-resistant coatings and fireproofing options are available.

Pre-Construction Phase

Site analysis and structural load assessment

Customized steel design and shop drawings

BOQs and project budgeting

Permit application support

Fabrication & Supply

Factory-controlled precision steel fabrication

Surface treatments: hot-dip galvanizing, epoxy coating, powder coating

Paneling, fasteners, and accessories provision

Erection & Completion

On-site steel structure assembly

Roofing, wall cladding, and flashing installation

Civil and MEP coordination

Testing, certification, and final commissioning

Industrial Steel Workshop – Riyadh

40m clear-span steel frame with 10-ton overhead crane

Full wall cladding with translucent skylight panels

Cold Storage Steel Facility – Dammam

Insulated PUF panel walls and roofing

Steel racking-ready floor with ventilation ductwork

Automotive Showroom – Al Khobar

Modern façade with glazed steel structure

Pre-engineered mezzanine level and branded signage support

Over a decade of experience in steel construction and industrial facilities

In-house team of structural engineers, safety officers, and site supervisors

Transparent project planning and milestone tracking

Advanced machinery and modern fabrication techniques

Commitment to quality, safety, and on-time delivery

Whether you’re planning a new industrial facility, a logistics warehouse, or a multi-level steel-framed commercial building, Hilink is your expert partner for delivering durable, compliant, and efficient steel structures in Saudi Arabia.

📞 Call Us: +966 561426663
📩 Email: info@powersystems-ksa.com

Powersystem is a Saudi-based construction company committed to delivering high-quality, future-ready infrastructure solutions. We specialize in innovative, sustainable construction projects with a strong focus on precision, reliability, and long-term value.

To be the leading force in redefining commercial and retail construction across Saudi Arabia.
We envision a future where every mall and strip mall reflects innovation, sustainability, and smart design.
Powersystem aims to set new benchmarks in quality and client satisfaction.
We strive to transform spaces into dynamic hubs that serve communities and businesses alike.
Our vision is driven by excellence, technology, and a deep understanding of evolving urban needs.

To deliver exceptional construction solutions tailored to the unique demands of modern retail and commercial environments.
We are committed to using advanced technologies, eco-friendly materials, and efficient processes.
At Powersystem, we prioritize client goals, operational efficiency, and long-term value.
We build spaces that are functional, future-ready, and aligned with Saudi Arabia’s development vision.
Our mission is to turn ideas into enduring landmarks with integrity, precision, and purpose.
